questions.question: What is the measure of each interior angle of a regular hexagon?
questions.explanation: For a regular n-gon, each interior angle = (n - 2) × 180° / n. For hexagon (n = 6): (6 - 2) × 180° / 6 = 4 × 180° / 6 = 720° / 6 = 120°.
